description: Wasf phase 2 bake-off: title, language and summary of a document

title.description: The title of the document as its reader would see it, in the language the document is written in.

language.description: The main language of the document as a BCP 47 language tag, for example en-US or ar. If the document mixes languages, give the main one.

summary.description: A summary of the document in at most two sentences, in the language the document is written in.
